ValidationRule.description: Blocks products from a different park than Opportunity.Preferred_Park_Location__c. Skipped for All Locations products, blank locations, and Multiple / Undecided.
ValidationRule.errorConditionFormula: AND( Opportunity.RecordType.DeveloperName = "Taman_Safari", NOT(ISBLANK(TEXT(Product2.Park_Location__c))), TEXT(Product2.Park_Location__c) <> "All Locations", NOT(ISBLANK(TEXT(Opportunity.Preferred_Park_Location__c))), TEXT(Opportunity.Preferred_Park_Location__c) <> "Multiple / Undecided", TEXT(Product2.Park_Location__c) <> TEXT(Opportunity.Preferred_Park_Location__c) )
ValidationRule.errorMessage: This product belongs to a different park than the Opportunity's Preferred Park Location. Choose a product for the same park, an All Locations product, or set the location to Multiple / Undecided.
